meta.name: parallel-debugging
meta.description: Debug complex issues using competing hypotheses with parallel investigation, evidence collection, and root cause arbitration. Use this skill when debugging bugs with multiple potential causes, performing root cause analysis, or organizing parallel investigation workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行验证多个假设,揪出复杂 bug 的根因
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对原因不明的复杂 bug,想用并行调查法快速定位根因
copy.tagline_en: Parallelize hypothesis testing to pinpoint root causes of complex bugs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're stuck on a tricky bug with multiple possible causes and want a systematic way to find the root cause

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把复杂 bug 当成多个竞争假设来处理：它会按故障类别生成可能的根因，并行调查并收集证据，最后根据证据强弱仲裁出最可能的根因。
howto.when: 当 bug 有多个可能原因、需要根本原因分析，或问题跨多个模块时触发。

say.text: 这个接口超时但日志正常，请列出所有可能的假设并逐个排查。
say.note: 会生成竞争假设并行调查。

say.text: 帮我用 ACH 方法分析这个内存泄漏的根因。
say.note: 会分门别类收集证据并仲裁。

say.text: 这个 bug 跨了三个服务，请组织并行调查流程。
say.note: 会按故障模式分类并汇总证据。

howto.what_en: After enabling, Claude treats complex bugs as competing hypotheses: it generates potential root causes across failure categories, investigates in parallel, collects evidence, and arbitrates the most likely cause based on evidence strength.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a bug has multiple plausible causes, when root cause analysis is needed, or when the issue spans multiple modules.

say_en.text: This endpoint times out but logs look normal. List all possible hypotheses and investigate each one.
say_en.note: Generates competing hypotheses and investigates them in parallel.

say_en.text: Use the ACH method to analyze this memory leak root cause.
say_en.note: Categorizes evidence and arbitrates a conclusion.

say_en.text: This bug spans three services. Organize a parallel investigation workflow.
say_en.note: Classifies failure modes and consolidates evidence.
